name: rumble-end-of-battle-mill
about: v0.118.0: {{Rumble|X}} (During Attack) - at the end of the battle, discard X cards from the opposing decktop, minus the cost of the blocking Spirit that is now in the opposing Trash (FAQ 31592-31594, 31621: only a Spirit blocker counts, a returned blocker does not reduce, and the attacker must still be on the Field). Fergus (26RBS01-079, Rumble 3) attacks; unblocked it mills 3, blocked by a destroyed Cost 3 Spirit it mills 0.
